name: A Door That Is Not There

system.description:
Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

Create a silent image of a door, window, curtain or screen for ten minutes. Touch reveals the illusion.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
One visible unoccupied square within 4 squares.
Type
Magic / Utility

Create a silent flat image of a door, window, curtain or screen in the chosen square for ten minutes. It may include small natural movement and remains while you move. Physical contact reveals the image's illusory nature. You may end it freely or replace it with a new casting.
